item.title: The Thin Line Between Being Detailed and Being Petty
item.description: There is a good connection between details and development. The ability to pay attention to details is one of the yardsticks of an excellent individual. Virtually in every field of endeavour, what is common to most leaders is their obsession with details and what is familiar to most laggards is their utter disregard for details.… Continue reading The Thin Line Between Being Detailed and Being Petty
